stdout: One complete result JSON. Existing serial output, accepted-route/raw-row and final numeric-state checks remain.

stderrPhase.missing: Unavailable owner state is null. Missing phase lines do not prove completion.
stderrPhase.writes: Unbuffered stderr writes with partial-write and EINTR handling. No fsync claim.

allocationMeaning: MTLDevice.currentAllocatedSize is device resource allocation size. It is not process footprint or physically resident bytes.
boundaryMeaning: Layer markers follow layer settlement. Residency markers bracket commit/request/queue attachment. Return does not prove physical residency. Model-load markers follow MetalContext construction.
reportTiming: Request starts at prompt and excludes model load. Final readback and golden checks are outside decode. No speed claim.
